cd /workspace && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import sys, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import treap
from treap import Priors, fat_insert, fat_pop, fat_lag, fat_pairs

def brute_check(n=200, seed=0):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    pr = Priors()
    root = None
    model = {}   # key -> lag
    ver = 0
    for step in range(n):
        op = rng.random()
        if op < 0.55 or not model:
            key = (rng.randint(0,5), step)
            if key in model: continue
            root = fat_insert(root, key, ('r',key), pr.take(), ver)
            model[key] = 0
        else:
            key = rng.choice(list(model))
            thr = key[0] if rng.random() < 0.8 else None
            root, lag, cnt = fat_pop(root, key, thr, ver, 0)
            # expected
            elag = model.pop(key)
            if thr is not None:
                ecnt = sum(1 for k,v in model.items() if k[0] < thr)
                for k in list(model):
                    if k[0] < thr: model[k] += 1
            else:
                ecnt = 0
            assert lag == elag, (step,'lag',lag,elag)
            assert cnt == ecnt, (step,'cnt',cnt,ecnt,key,sorted(model))
        # verify all lags
        pairs = []
        fat_pairs(root, 0, pairs)
        got = {p[0][1]: lag for p,lag in pairs} if False else {p.oid if False else p[1][0]: lag for p,lag in pairs}
        got = {}
        for p, lag in pairs:
            got[p[1]] = lag
        assert got == model, (step, 'pairs', got, model)
        # verify fat_lag
        for k, v in model.items():
            assert fat_lag(root, k) == v, (step,'lagof',k,fat_lag(root,k),v)
    print('brute ok', n)

for s in range(30):
    brute_check(150, s)
PYEOF
